name: CKAD25-AC
question: Does native prior-intervention hazard learning from 3 genuinely observed changing-source worlds transfer to a fresh target world when the visible identities of anomalous action roles have undergone a hidden bijective reassignment? With no visible mapping sensor, the prospective expectation is a NO-GO; distinguish from stable-ID confirmation.
mechanism: Reuse exact existing NativeCumulativeLearner.propose_source_change_witnesses and validate_causal_source_with_witnesses, with actual source-pinned A/B/C acquisition and six previous actual action histories, under two independently frozen target conditions: STABLE retains the prior fault location visible label; REASSIGNED draws fresh uniformly random bijection of FOUR candidate action address labels and the changed latent role's outcome occurs at its new visible address. Source model C's baseline is unchanged on all visible addresses, meaning this is a controlled mutation-location identity reassignment, NOT a full change of action semantics, operator grammar or unknown causal graph. No identity mapping, generator role or held consequence is passed to native or equal-information comparator.
generator: Fresh independent seeds and source-weight function generator using CKAD25-AB precommitted source logic; per seed choose 12 source fit and 4 unobserved candidate 4-bit public action addresses. Learn 3 independent action-sensitive exactly three-term GF2 laws A/B/C in one native source snapshot; cold restore. Draw hidden recurring fault role, 3 real two-address historical do observations of changed C worlds with latent fault role favored p=.75, otherwise any one of other 3 roles p=1/12 each. The history is stored as native verified source slots12..14. Eight future target worlds per seed: 6 changed and 2 unchanged. For each seed/stage run paired STABLE and REASSIGNED conditions with identical latent fault role; REASSIGNED's new bijection of 4 candidate role->observable address generated from separate seed and is NEVER exposed to any policy. Full C outputs at visible addresses unchanged except single changed location; target-world source identification uses exactly 4 fresh source-address do outcomes. Every policy arm spends exactly 2 new diagnostic do actions; the other 2 candidate action consequences are never observed before scoring.
controls: Independent exact conventional 697-rule source posterior with the same authenticated history and Beta(1,1) mismatch risk, required to exactly match native raw-address choices and scores. Fully marginalized uniform prior over all 24 possible action-role bijections yields EXACTLY equal expected anomaly rate at any visible address when permutation is hidden, so a conventionally optimal no-feature identity-unaware policy can only tie any fixed two on expected detection (same information). Equal-budget seeded random and fixed two are negative controls. A privileged mapping-aware upper bound is evaluator-only and cannot be used as a true learning comparator.
information_budget: 16 primary seeds x [36 genuinely observed A/B/C source actions +6 genuinely witnessed historical actions +8 target worlds x2 target conditions x5 policy arms x(4 witnessed source identity actions +2 new candidate consequences)] = 16*(42+480)=8352 charged source-only do consequences. 16x8x2x5=1280 policy-target cases, x2 held=2560 conditional held evaluations, but 16x8x2x4=1024 unique seed-world-condition-candidate truth bits. All policy arms have equal target action budget (6 do actions). Held address identities vary by policy and are secondary, not a paired outcome; primary detection compares the same latent faults across all arms and both conditions. Identity permutations are generated independently of latent role and NOT given to candidate.
safety: Source-only synthetic engineering experiment, no protected original-world first use, no accepted ref/merge, no Forge dispatch, no new controller/scheduler, no paid API, source owner and science gates separately.

frozen_primary.replay: Original exact source and primary seed result bytes must match Linux/Windows; independent reconstruction of every witnessed do consequence, observed permutation marginal, held truth and score; old native source and 3 learned C-class committees plus 3 witnessed history slots retain exact cold bytes.
frozen_primary.source_budget: Exactly 8352 source-free genuine observed outcomes, 2560 never-witnessed held forecasts, no hidden role, mapping, prior fault or held bit passed into native/controls. Source and target actions disjoint.
frozen_primary.stable_replication: On 96 STABLE shifted world cases, native detection >= fixed and random +0.08 absolute; no more than 2 excess confident wrong held vs either; 0/32 stable false alarms, prior history organically observes hidden hotspot in >=8/16 seeds.
frozen_primary.transfer_minimum: On 96 REASSIGNED shifted world cases, native detection must exceed BOTH fixed and independently seeded random by >=0.08 absolute with zero spurious 32 stationary alarms; and native REASSIGNED detection must remain within 0.08 of the native STABLE detection. Expected to FAIL because the mapping was not observed.
frozen_primary.conventional: Native and independently fitted exact conventional 697-rule + Beta hazard must pick exactly same two actions in BOTH conditions on all 256 seed-world pairs, exactly same source decisions and held metrics; permutation-marginalized conventional's p(fault at any visible address)=1/4 must be audited; any claim of unique algorithmic superiority is false.
frozen_primary.no_held_leak: No policy may observe post-action remaining two bits or mapping; source-trained original memory source/properties and cold-restored A/B/C committees remain invariant; no mutation of previous PR source.

disposition: If stable + transfer criteria and all custody/control checks PASS => TRANSFER_DEV_SIGNAL ONLY, SCIENTIFIC_PASS=false due conventional parity and synthetic fixed grammar. If stable passes, transfer fails => DISTINCT_IDENTITY_TRANSFER_NO_GO, preserve negative. If stable fails too => DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO. Any hidden mapping leakage, incorrect action accounting, missing conventional parity or source corruption => INVALID. Regardless: no universal unfamiliar-world transfer, science acceptance or deployment.
stop: One dev-only fixture seed78999 before first primary frozen sixteen seeds. One original new sixteen-seed first use per OS; cross-OS repeated same cohort for byte determinism not independent scientific replication. No post-hoc tuning of this consumed cohort; if null, stop instead of searching thresholds. Source-only audit and final full regression + G29 after evidence seal. Exactly same native model: no new controller, owner runner, accepted main or forgeries.
